notes.title: JUNKPUNK : ARENA OPENS TONIGHT!!!
notes.notes:
JUNKPUNK : ARENA is opening tonight, at midnight EST! Are you ready to test your metal against your opponents? Make sure you have a friend online, and get ready to jump into a smash and crash action event with your friends! 

Thank you to everyone who's helped support the game by wishlisting it! It means the world to us at Eggs with Legs, and we appreciate you! We hope you enjoy the game we've worked on!
